_comment: Metadata for the Kenney Tiny Town sprite set. This is a temporary placeholder set used during early development. Will be replaced by the 'pixel' set as Conquer-native sprites are produced.
name: Kenney Tiny Town
author: Kenney Vleugels (kenney.nl)
description: CC0-licensed pixel art sprite pack from Kenney. Used as placeholder assets during early development to allow renderer testing without blocking on asset production. Will be replaced by Conquer-native pixel art ('pixel' set) over time.

dimensions._note: Tiny Town is natively 16x16 px. The renderer should scale these up 2x (nearest-neighbor) to match Conquer's 32x32 logical tile size.

missing_categories: water (no water tiles in this pack)
completeness._note: This pack is for Phase 0 prototyping only. Use it to validate the renderer and tile system. Replace with proper Conquer pixel art before public release.
